kickoff.title: Set up your space
kickoff.intro: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time. It first asks which features you want, then starts with the basics: your mailbox, Google sign-in, the support inbox and imports from your other tools. Each step says how long it takes, and you can skip any of them and come back any time.
kickoff.keyFirst: First, an AI model key: your agent needs one to answer. Type it into the card below; the agent never sees it.
kickoff.demoTitle: Want to see it working first?
kickoff.demoBody: Open your own temporary copy of a sample company at {{host}}, pick what you want to see, and follow its guided scenarios. Nothing to install.
